value.rationale: The exact inverse map permits two hidden unequal environmental switching rates to be recovered from only stationary second and fourth-order spatial observables without measuring the switching events. The globally sharp attainable region is a physically interpretable model-consistency test and establishes that no other positive rate pair can fit those two measurements. This structurally motivated inverse classification is not a routine forward-moment recalculation; no claims about finite-sample efficiency or uncalibrated parameters are made.
